messages:
Ana (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock Q3 hosted-api commitments by end of week. top candidates: embeddings SLO, chat median latency, rerank accuracy. thoughts?
Devon (Eng): embeddings SLO sounds high impact but expensive. what's the hard SLO number?
Ana (PM): aiming for embeddings 95th <= 100ms on hosted for common seq lengths, chat median < 60ms, rerank +8% precision over baseline.
Samir (SRE): 100ms at 95th is aggressive for some models. KV cache + prefix caching will help. also need fallback model routes.
Mira (Product Ops): enterprise customers pushing region + private deploys — that adds config/ops work if we promise SLOs.
Luis (Data Sci): rerank baseline P@10 = 0.56 on our eval set. target 0.60 is doable but might increase latency/cost.
Devon (Eng): technical tradeoffs: batching and async prefix warming reduce cost/latency. infra ask: +4GB GPU ram per node for KV caching in worst case.
Ana (PM): proposal: prioritize embeddings SLO + chat latency for Q3. put rerank into a focused spike to quantify cost/latency tradeoffs before committing. Dedicated/private customers get a parallel track.
Devon (Eng): agree with prioritization. spike needed for batching perf — @Samir can you own batching perf spike? estimate 2w.
Samir (SRE): I can own it. will run perf matrix across sequence lengths and model variants starting Monday.
Mira (Product Ops): rollout constraints: we should require canary by customer tier (dev->beta->enterprise) and a runbook for rollback.
Ana (PM): canary plan (draft): 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows and automated perf rollback if 95th exceeds threshold.
Devon (Eng): add routing rule: if latency > threshold then fallback to quantized smaller variant. I'll draft a config PR for dynamic routing.
Luis (Data Sci): for rerank spike I'll prepare the tuned dataset and eval harness, measure perf with beam sizes and top-k candidates.
Samir (SRE): monitoring needed: token-level latency, KV cache hit rate, batching efficiency. will add dashboards and alert thresholds.
rollout-bot: Deployment checklist created: /deploy/checklists/hosted-q3-slo-canary (owner: Ana).
Ana (PM): decisions recorded: 1) Q3 focus = embeddings SLO + chat med latency. 2) Rerank -> research spike (not committed to ship). 3) Private/Dedicated scoped separately. 4) Spike owners: Devon (batching infra) + Luis (rerank eval).
Mira (Product Ops): next steps: update OKRs and add acceptance criteria to the epic. ops will prepare runbooks and compliance checklist.
Devon (Eng): I'll open tickets today: perf-spike-embeddings, fallback-routing-config, canary-runbook.
Ana (PM): thanks all — sync Fri 10am to lock tickets and owners. :thumbsup:
